visual_identity.core_identity: A normal fantasy sword animated by magic, moving and attacking with no hand, arm, ghost, or visible wielder.
visual_identity.silhouette: One complete sword with clear blade, guard, grip, and pommel suspended in open air.
visual_identity.head_features: No head, eyes, mouth, face, or biological features.
visual_identity.body_shape: The sword itself is the entire creature; no added torso, limbs, wings, or hidden operator.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No limbs. Motion comes from magical levitation and changes in the sword's orientation.
visual_identity.surface: Clean blade and simple hilt with broad colorable metal and grip regions and minimal ornament.
must_keep: readable blade guard grip and pommel

scene_identity.size_impression: A single ordinary weapon-sized construct whose threat comes from unnatural unsupported motion.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Suspended horizontally, diagonally, or point-forward in open space with no visible support.

accuracy_checks: one complete sword is the dominant creature
no wielder or hidden hand appears
airborne support is clearly magical rather than attached

known_failure_modes.symptom: ghost, hand, or humanoid appears to operate the sword
known_failure_modes.correction: remove the operator and show the sword alone in unsupported magical motion
restore one single complete sword as the only monster subject
